Metadata.title: Cabañas Don Augusto | Your Nature Retreat in Costa Rica
Metadata.description: Discover Cabañas Don Augusto in San Isidro, Peñas Blancas. Enjoy privacy, birdsong, tropical forest, and a nearby river in the La Fortuna region.

Home.location: San Isidro, Peñas Blancas · Costa Rica
Home.title: Cabañas Don Augusto
Home.subtitle: Your peaceful nature retreat near La Fortuna.
Home.description: Wake up to birdsong, breathe in the fresh forest air, and enjoy the peace and privacy you deserve. Surrounded by lush greenery and a nearby river, this is your place to slow down and reconnect with nature.
Home.cabinsTitle: A place to create lasting memories
Home.cabinsDescription: Discover our three cabins surrounded by tropical greenery, where relaxation and a close connection with nature are part of the experience.
Home.cabinsPlaceholder: Explore photos, amenities, and details about each cabin soon.
Home.aboutTitle: Disconnect from the noise. Reconnect with nature.
Home.aboutDescription: Here, the peaceful rhythm of the forest sets the pace for your stay. Relax, listen to birdsong, and discover the beauty of Costa Rica's wildlife.
Home.wildlifeDescription: Listen to the birds and enjoy opportunities to spot wildlife in its natural habitat.
Home.privacyDescription: Find your own space to unwind, share special moments, and escape the rush of everyday life.
Home.riverDescription: Experience lush tropical surroundings and the natural beauty of a river near our cabins.
Home.regionTitle: An unforgettable nature experience in Costa Rica
Home.regionDescription: Make Cabañas Don Augusto the destination of your trip. Enjoy the peaceful forest surroundings and discover the attractions of La Fortuna and the Arenal region during your stay.
Home.contactDescription: We welcome you to Cabañas Don Augusto for peaceful moments surrounded by nature. Explore our location and start planning your visit.

Footer.description: A peaceful nature retreat where privacy, relaxation, and the beauty of the tropical forest come together.
